zh: 都柏林大学（University College Dublin，简称 UCD）成立于1854年，是爱尔兰最大的大学，也是一所综合性研究型大学。学校位于爱尔兰首都都柏林，其前身为天主教大学，后来发展成为一所世俗化的高等教育机构。UCD以其在医学、商业、法律、工程、计算机科学等领域的教学和研究而著称，是爱尔兰高等教育的重要支柱。
en: University College Dublin (UCD) was founded in 1854 and is Ireland's largest university and a comprehensive research university. Located in Dublin

address.zh: the university originated as the Catholic University and later developed into a secular higher education institution. UCD is renowned for its teaching and research in medicine
